Project

Description:

Rajasthan Medical journal

 

Project Inception

The aim of the Rajasthan Medical Journal (RMJ) web application is to function as an intellectual platform where scientists, researchers, and academics can actively participate in valuable discussions and exchange their profound scientific endeavors. This includes the dissemination of innovative concepts, theories, and research findings. The project is dedicated to upholding a strong commitment to presenting scientific contributions with comprehensive detail to promote a thorough comprehension and encourage subsequent exploration. 

 

The RMJ follows the evaluation and publication protocols set forth by the International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE). Its primary objective is to encourage and advance research within the medical domain, all while adhering to the motto of enhancing the well-being of individuals and promoting effective healthcare within society.

 

 

RajCAD Contribution : Functional Requirement Specification(FRS)/ Web Application Development/ Analytics

 

Approach and Objectives  

 

The aim of the Rajasthan Medical Journal (RMJ) web application is to function as an intellectual platform where scientists, researchers, and academics can actively participate in valuable discussions and exchange their profound scientific endeavors. This includes the dissemination of innovative concepts, theories, and research findings. The project is dedicated to upholding a strong commitment to presenting scientific contributions with comprehensive detail to promote a thorough comprehension and encourage subsequent exploration.

 

Stakeholders 

  • S.M.S Medical collage 
  • Citizen 
  • Doctors and Researchers
  • DoIT&C/RajCAD

Outcome 

  • Reduced manual intervention, therefore no delay and rework.
  • Reduce turnaround time for complete process.
  • Improve transparency, efficiency and accountability of users. 
  • The tracking of verification done by admin, Editor and Reviewers can be recorded.
  • Acknowledgement and Notifications will streamline communication among the stakeholders. 
  • The system will monitor statistics such as the number of research articles, real-time status of process.      

 

Functionalities 

 

  • Web Application Development 

 

  1. On boarding of department users and Role Mapping 
  2. Configure Master (Article Types, Department)
  3. Workflow of the verification and approval process of submitted applications for timely regularization.
  4. Report Generation

 

  • Integration with Standard Platforms 
    1. Raj-Masters
    2. e-Sanchar
    3. SSO gateway
    4. E-sign

     

    • Dashboard
      1. At-A-Glance Reports & MIS Reports 

       

      Users and their roles:

       

      1. Admin (SMS Medical College ) 
      • Super Admin
      • Monitoring of Portal 
      • Mapping of  Editor, Reviewer 
      • Check Plagiarism and manuscript format 
      • Authority to Approve/Reject/ Publish the  manuscript  
      • Viewing Authority (Dashboard)

       

      1. Editor 
      • Assigning Manuscript to Reviewers
      • Authority to suggest admin to approve/reject/accept with revision the manuscript 
      • Viewing Authority (Dashboard)

       

      1. Reviewer 
      • Agree/Disagree to review the assigned manuscript 
      • Verify the article/research and Provide Observations/Shortcomings and Suggestions to editor with remark 
      • Viewing Authority (Dashboard)

       

      1. Author 
      • Registration  as an author through SSO, The RMJ Application
      • Submit/ Edit/ Revise manuscript on web application 
      • Viewing Authority (Dashboard)

       

      Technological Framework

      • Front End : Angular JS
      • Back End :  JAVA
      • Database :  Oracle 19c
      • Analytics :  Tableau
